title: test: flash sign roundtrip oracle should reimport DER from keystore
description: test/wp11_test_pkcs11.c -- test_flash_pkcs11_sign_roundtrip() keeps the EC key in memory (orig_ecc) as the oracle for signature verification. This does not prove that the keystore serialization/deserialization round-trip preserves key bits correctly: if the DER write corrupts bits but the in-memory key is identical, the test still passes. Fix: after loading the keystore, export the private key DER from the loaded key object, import it into a fresh ecc_key with wc_EccPrivateKeyDecode(), and verify the signature with that. This independently proves the keystore preserved the private key.
